inclusion_criteria: Adult participant with documented informed consent for the declared measurements and reuse boundary.
At least eight valid driver swings after prespecified quality exclusions.
All required non-EMG streams synchronized within their declared uncertainty bounds.
exclusion_criteria: Unresolved coordinate-calibration failure or inverse-dynamics residual above threshold.
Missing bilateral hand-wrench, club, or ground-reaction data in the primary event window.
Any participant whose held-out assignment was disclosed before model and threshold freeze.

predictions.estimand: Late-window distal interface drift-work share under uncertainty-propagated inverse dynamics.
predictions.expected_sign_or_interval: Participant-level median drift work is positive in the registered late window.
predictions.falsifier: The hierarchical interval includes the predeclared negligible region or reconstruction/residual gates fail.
predictions.analysis_level: participant-level estimates followed by hierarchical partial pooling

predictions.estimand: Within-swing association between force-velocity alignment and transported wrench power around registered sign crossings.
predictions.expected_sign_or_interval: Power changes sign with the registered projection while force magnitude alone does not explain the crossing.
predictions.falsifier: Sign-crossing order falls outside the synchronization interval or disappears under frame/reference transport controls.

predictions.estimand: Late negative equivalent club couple conditional on low measured distal activation and sensitivity-bounded passive terms.
predictions.expected_sign_or_interval: A negative interval persists beyond combined timing and inverse-dynamics uncertainty in a declared subset.
predictions.falsifier: The sign is explained by measured active/passive contributions or is not stable to residual and filtering sensitivity.
predictions.analysis_level: observational participant-level interval; no causal passivity claim

predictions.estimand: Timing interval between opposing distal EMG onset, modeled drift-force reversal, and held-out delivery outcomes.
predictions.expected_sign_or_interval: Opposing activation precedes the registered reversal by more than synchronization uncertainty and predicts held-out outcomes after declared covariates.
predictions.falsifier: No anticipatory interval or held-out association remains after onset, filtering, and multiplicity sensitivity.
predictions.analysis_level: observational timing and prediction; no causal neural strategy claim

filtering_contract.primary: zero-lag fourth-order Butterworth with cutoff selected before outcome access

inference_boundary: Observed timing and association do not establish that a modeled controller or passive mechanism caused a human outcome.
